method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Rotation/scale-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the chassis rocking/slump and the slinky/cord/neck/suspension stretch (child translation along the parent axis) are the intentional translations. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof (the Blender attachment audit covers listed part pairs).
